evidence.quote: Turning to inflation, it is alarmingly high, persistent, and has broadened to affect more categories of goods and services, compared with earlier this year.
I believe an increase in the target range for the federal funds rate will be warranted shortly after our asset purchases end.
I strongly supported the Committee's decision this week to speed up the pace of the tapering of asset purchases.
In light of November's job report, I believe the economy is closing in on maximum employment.
I have argued for some time that there are upside risks to inflation
the FOMC is providing flexibility for other adjustments to monetary policy, if needed, as early as spring
